column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for coordination and evaluation records (e.g., 'COORD0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry) (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry) (e.g., 'OPS0001').
An INT logging how many security incidents have occurred (e.g., 2).
An enum (SafetyRanking_enum) describing safety level; values: 'Safe', 'Moderate', 'High Risk'.
An enum (AccessLimitation_enum) capturing access restrictions; values: 'Severe', 'Partial'.
An enum (CoordEffectLvl_enum) indicating coordination effectiveness; values: 'Medium', 'Low', 'High'.
A TEXT field listing partner organizations or supporting groups (e.g., 'NGO-A; LocalGov; RedCross').
An enum (InfoSharingState_enum) for information sharing; values: 'Poor', 'Limited', 'Effective'.
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring compliance with reporting (e.g., 9.0).
An INT rating data quality (e.g., 85).
An enum (MonitoringFreq_enum) capturing monitoring frequency; values: 'Monthly', 'Daily', 'Weekly'.
An enum (EvaluationStage_enum) describing current evaluation status; values: 'Overdue', 'Due', 'Current'.
An enum (LessonsLearnedStage_enum) for how lessons learned documentation is handled; values: 'In Progress', 'Documented', 'Pending'.
An enum (ContingencyPlanStage_enum) for contingency plan status; values: 'Overdue', 'Due', 'Updated'.
An enum (RiskMitigationSteps_enum) describing risk mitigation actions; values: 'Insufficient', 'Partial', 'Adequate'.
An enum (InsuranceScope_enum) labeling insurance coverage; values: 'Full', 'Partial'.
An enum (ComplianceState_enum) capturing compliance level; values: 'Partial', 'Compliant', 'Non-Compliant'.
An enum (AuditState_enum) indicating audit status; values: 'Completed', 'Due', 'Overdue'.
An enum (QualityControlSteps_enum) explaining quality control measures; values: 'Moderate', 'Strong', 'Weak'.
A NUMERIC(3,2) rating stakeholder satisfaction (e.g., 8.75).
An enum (MediaCoverSentiment_enum) denoting media coverage tone; values: 'Positive', 'Neutral', 'Negative'.
A DECIMAL(5,1) capturing public perception measure (e.g., 75.2).
An enum (DocumentationState_enum) labeling completeness of documentation; values: 'Partial', 'Incomplete', 'Complete'.
A TEXT field noting documented lessons (e.g., 'More pre-disaster drills needed.').
A TEXT field capturing recognized best practices (e.g., 'Daily stand-up meetings, decentralized supply hubs.').
A TEXT field logging improvement recommendations (e.g., 'Upgrade transport routes, increase staff training.').
A DATE indicating when the next review is scheduled (e.g., '2026-01-15').
A TEXT field for extra commentary or insights from coordinators, unbounded length.
